subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Should OpenClaw accept this custom yielding glob walker and bootstrap-hook scheduling as the bounded fix for the linked bootstrap-context stall despite possible prompt-order and session-timing changes?
rationale: The patch is technically sound and well-proven, but bootstrap context and hook ordering feed compatibility-sensitive prompt and session behavior that automation should not redefine unilaterally.

options.title: Land After Exact-Head Validation
options.body: Accept the bounded compatibility tradeoff and merge once the current head is green and reviewed against current main.

options.title: Request Live Channel Proof
options.body: Require one current-head embedded run with active channel or WebSocket liveness evidence before accepting the scheduling change.

options.title: Pause For Broader Architecture
options.body: Keep or close the PR if maintainers prefer worker isolation, priority scheduling, or caching instead of this focused mitigation.

recommendation.title: Land After Exact-Head Validation
recommendation.body: Accept the bounded compatibility tradeoff and merge once the current head is green and reviewed against current main.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history spans the internal hook, bootstrap hook, and guarded workspace-read surfaces changed by this PR.
